verdict.rationale: Selective track subscription is a fair question for a real-time video platform, so the axis applies. However, the pack has no documentation of an agent or server-side participant subscribing to just one published track. The Network Bandwidth Profile API only prioritizes participant video tracks, and track recordings are post-hoc rather than live subscription; both are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent subscribes to a single track of a live broadcast without the publisher changing anything about how it publishes
